conventions: The ASV's list of the wicked's fate (vv. 17–18, 30) opens each colon with 'That'. Only the waw of v.17b (וְיָבֹא) licenses one and takes it under rule 14; the 'That' of v.17c, v.18a and v.30b stands over asyndetic clauses and is added under rule 55. The cleft 'is it that' of v.17a is likewise added (rule 20), and the speech frame 'Ye say' of v.19 is one added unit (rule 2).
report: Checked all 37 candidate lemmas; every difference is licensed by what the ASV wrote, none is a construction analysed two ways.
לִפְנֵי: v.8 splits ('in their sight' spends a word on each morpheme, rule 2) while vv.18 and 33 fuse as 'before' (rule 30) — correct on both sides.

Silenced prepositions (v.5 אֶל 'Mark me', v.22 לְ 'teach God', v.26 עַל 'covereth them', v.27 עַל 'wrong me', v.31 לְ 'repay him') are all rule 40 recastings; the same lemmas are aligned where the ASV writes a word (vv.19, 26a, 33).

Supplied subordinators: v.17's second clause gives 'That' to its waw (rule 14) while v.17c, v.18 and v.30b, which have no conjunction, leave 'That' added (rule 55) — consistent count across the chapter.

Supplied subjects: lexical nouns 'God' (v.17) and 'men' (v.32) are added under rule 17; the indefinite pronoun 'any' (v.22) stays with the impersonal verb as its subject pronoun. Defensible and not a split.

BSB disagreements: v.4 אִם (madua holds 'why', so the auxiliary is the verb's under rule 17's limit), v.6 apodosis waw, v.11 paragogic nun, and the five rule-40 prepositions are all documented convention differences; none is an error.
Repeated notes (assimilated article, prepositional-predicate copula, waw → Seeing) restate rules 12, 49 and 14 and need no convention. Nothing in this chapter generalises beyond the contract.
